title: Specific constitutional variants → tissue phenotype
mechanism: CYP21A2–TNXB disruption supplies a defined endocrine/connective-tissue interface.
uncertainty: This does not validate the broad RCCX neurodevelopmental cluster. The autonomic frequency in selected hEDS/HSD clinics cannot be generalized to all carriers.
falsifier: A prespecified RCCX contribution must add replicated prediction beyond broader constitutional measures.
rival: Other genetic and clinical pathways explain similar tissue findings outside CAH-X.

title: Birth conditions → AVP / copeptin response
mechanism: Delivery-associated AVP/copeptin differences are reported across human studies.
uncertainty: An acute peripheral signal does not establish persistent neural calibration; OXT is not interchangeable.
falsifier: A persistent-developmental claim needs longitudinal effects beyond the transient birth response.
rival: Obstetric indication and the acute transition explain the cord signal without lasting calibration.

title: Maternal ecology → infant strain inheritance
mechanism: Maternal gut reservoirs, delivery, feeding and subsequent contacts shape measured strain acquisition.
uncertainty: Delivery label is a proxy; observational transmission does not establish a behavioral effect.
falsifier: The nominated strain/function fails to add held-out prediction of prespecified outcomes.
rival: Delivery mode is a marker for feeding, maternal reservoirs, antibiotics, and household ecology.

title: L. reuteri → vagus / OXT / VTA social plasticity
mechanism: Vagal integrity and oxytocin signaling participate in experimentally observed social-behavior rescue.
uncertainty: The complete pathway has not been causally demonstrated in humans.
falsifier: Replicated pathway-specific disruption fails to alter the effect in the nominated preparation.
rival: Other microbial metabolites or immune routes mediate the mouse social effect.

title: L. reuteri formulation → selected human outcomes
mechanism: Human trials provide limited social or adaptive-behavior signals.
uncertainty: Global autism severity is not consistently improved; human OXT/vagus mediation remains unproven.
falsifier: Adequately powered replication fails on prespecified social outcomes.
rival: Trial-specific formulation effects, chance, or multiple endpoints explain the selected benefit.

title: Thrombospondin–α₂δ-1 → synaptogenesis
scope: Rodent neural preparations and developing mouse cortex
mechanism: α₂δ-1 participates in excitatory synapse formation; postsynaptic Rac1 is mechanistically implicated.
uncertainty: Not identical to presynaptic trafficking; not a demonstrated consequence of birth mode. A later binding assay found soluble TSP4–α₂δ-1 binding was gabapentin-insensitive; binding and synapse outcomes must be separated.
falsifier: Orthogonal replication fails for the specified receptor-dependent synaptogenic effect.
rival: Thrombospondin signaling acts through downstream partners independently of CaV trafficking.

title: α₂δ maturation → release regulation
mechanism: Proteolytic maturation of α₂δ affects channel association and vesicular release probability.
uncertainty: No verified human perinatal cleavage abnormality is inferred.
falsifier: Selective maturation manipulation fails to reproduce the release effect in the claimed preparation.
rival: Other maturation proteins or activity-dependent changes explain release regulation.

title: Development → channel contribution reallocation
mechanism: Presynaptic channel contributions change during development in the studied synapse.
uncertainty: Not a universal brain switch, a human-age calibration, or proof of arrested development. Mouse expression profiling found stage- and region-specific programs; one activity-blockade condition did not alter the measured expression profile.
falsifier: Within-preparation replication contradicts the specified temporal change.
rival: Intrinsic developmental programs explain the channel shift without the nominated exposure.

title: Perinatal signals → α₂δ–CaV2 state
scope: Target developmental stage must be specified
mechanism: Endocrine, immune or microbial signals might alter channel organization and synaptogenesis.
uncertainty: This is the main missing bridge. Molecular plausibility does not demonstrate it.
falsifier: Precise null exposure effects, or failed mediator disruption/rescue, weaken the nominated bridge.
rival: Early exposure affects networks through a pathway that bypasses α₂δ/CaV2.

title: Network calibration → regulatory phenotype
mechanism: Synaptic organization may influence later sensory, autonomic and affiliative regulation.
uncertainty: The integrated mapping lacks direct longitudinal validation; many bypasses are possible.
falsifier: The specified network measures fail to predict or mediate the targeted outcome.
rival: Ongoing sleep, pain, reward and social learning explain later regulation without an early molecular mediator.

title: Regulatory phenotype × environment → closure
mechanism: RCB compares positive external and internal regulatory gains on the same scale.
uncertainty: Not a validated trait, diagnosis, or normative scoring tool.
falsifier: Poor reliability or no incremental out-of-sample interaction beyond conventional measures.
rival: Conventional arousal, executive function or reward sensitivity explains task-dependent gains.

title: Regulation + context → developmental reorganization
mechanism: Different support and load trajectories may produce recovery, reorganization or persistent impairment.
uncertainty: The bifurcation is not an established biological stage model; outcomes are not moral ranks.
falsifier: Operationalized trajectories fail to replicate or the construct adds no value over alternatives.
rival: Resources, support and treatment explain trajectories without a discrete reorganization process.

title: Human–AI coupling → conversion and dissemination
mechanism: Responsive tools may reduce implementation costs but can increase branching and dependence.
uncertainty: AI writing evidence does not establish an RCB-specific advantage or civilizational inversion.
falsifier: Independent RCB fails to predict the nominated environment interaction on verified completed output.
rival: Generic AI assistance and unequal opportunity explain output changes without phenotype-specific selection.

title: Early immune ecology → disgust sensitivity calibration
mechanism: Early immune/microbial conditions might influence later pathogen avoidance.
uncertainty: Adult disgust associations do not establish early microbial causation or political consequences.
falsifier: No replicated prospective relationship with age-appropriate germ-aversion measures.
rival: Current learning and culture explain disgust variation without early microbial calibration.

title: Phenotype → selected environment → later phenotype
mechanism: Actions change subsequent exposure, reinforcement and support, feeding into later regulation.
uncertainty: A cyclic diagram is not an identified causal model; time-order and confounding matter.
falsifier: Time-indexed interventions and predictions fail against a nonfeedback alternative.
rival: Stable traits and environments jointly cause behavior and exposure without strong selection feedback.

title: Birth mode → categorical ASD / ADHD
mechanism: Fully adjusted NHS II estimates are compatible with no association.
uncertainty: Null categorical effects constrain broad claims; they do not test every dimensional mediator.
falsifier: A well-identified replicated causal estimate would change this assessment.
rival: Confounding explains crude birth-mode associations; adjusted categorical effects are near null.

title: VMT assignment → 12-month social-emotional score
mechanism: Randomized VMT versus saline favored a social-emotional score; global ASQ-3 was not significant.
uncertainty: No identified strain or α₂δ mediator; vaginal reference group was not randomized.
falsifier: Larger preregistered replication fails to confirm the specific outcome.
rival: The intervention affects social scores through a pathway independent of the named organism or molecular hinge.

title: RCCX susceptibility → α₂δ hinge
scope: No direct evidence located in this pass
mechanism: Constitution could modify sensitivity to developmental perturbation.
uncertainty: Specific RCCX-to-channel mediation is unproven; genomic proximity is insufficient. ADHD GWAS is polygenic; a C4 schizophrenia result does not establish this neurodevelopmental bridge.
falsifier: No prespecified RCCX interaction or incremental prediction in independent cohorts.
rival: Distributed genetic architecture and independent perinatal factors explain the data without an RCCX–hinge link.

title: Phenibut pharmacology → hypothesis generation
mechanism: R-phenibut has α₂δ and GABA-B pharmacological activity.
uncertainty: Adult response does not diagnose a target-specific or developmental lesion.
falsifier: The developmental inference is not identified by a response; it requires independent tests.
rival: GABA-B effects, expectancy, or current state explain an adult response without developmental α₂δ pathology.

title: Constitution × perinatal conditions → initialization
mechanism: Measured constitutional factors may change responses to perinatal exposures.
uncertainty: The broad interaction is not established by CAH-X or molecular synapse studies.
falsifier: Prespecified constitutional effect modification fails in adequately precise independent studies.
rival: Constitution and perinatal conditions contribute additively, with no specific interaction.

title: Early adversity ↔ stress-regulatory methylation
scope: Human postmortem and blood observational studies; tissue and age differ
mechanism: Adversity history is associated with some NR3C1 or FKBP5 methylation and expression measures in selected samples.
uncertainty: A 113-dyad study found no direct transfer at assayed newborn sites, and a 3,965-person population study did not replicate a maltreatment interaction. This cannot identify a universal inherited mark.
falsifier: Prospective, cell-composition-aware replication should show the nominated site and direction across independent cohorts.
rival: Genotype, cell mixture, current illness, shared environment, and selection explain the associations.

title: Task event rate → attention performance
scope: Go/No-Go ADHD task meta-analysis; not a general personality scale
mechanism: Slow event rates disproportionately slowed ADHD groups; fast rates increased commission-error effects in the reviewed tasks.
uncertainty: General ADHD–control differences persisted and reaction-time variability did not show the predicted event-rate effect.
falsifier: Matched within-person task crossovers fail to reproduce event-rate interactions beyond task demands.
rival: Specific task learning or reward expectations, rather than regulatory closure, explain the pattern.

title: Camouflaging is measurable; broad masking remains a bridge
mechanism: The CAT-Q measured reported social camouflaging in autistic and non-autistic adults.
uncertainty: This does not prove unconscious homeostatic masking across ADHD, trauma, or other phenotypes.
falsifier: Longitudinal behavioral and physiological measures fail to distinguish generalized masking from social learning.
rival: Conventional social adaptation and context account for reported strategies.

title: Chronotype diversity → group-level nighttime coverage
scope: Hadza actigraphy, 20 days; no ADHD measure
mechanism: At least one group member was scored awake or in light sleep in 99.8% of sampled nighttime epochs.
uncertainty: The result supports group-level heterogeneity, not an ADHD subtype or general adaptive superiority.
falsifier: Comparable groups with mixed age and chronotype fail to show the predicted coverage.
rival: Age structure and ordinary awakenings explain the coverage without a specialized vigilance trait.

title: Hypermobility cohorts show heterogeneous autonomic profiles
mechanism: Autonomic testing identified varied profiles including POTS in 48% of this selected sample.
uncertainty: The figure is not a general-population prevalence and does not demonstrate RCCX, perinatal or α₂δ mediation.
falsifier: Population-based cohorts fail to reproduce an autonomic association under prespecified diagnostic criteria.
rival: Referral selection and comorbidity explain the high clinical frequency.

title: AI ideas → individual story gains and collective similarity
mechanism: Access to AI ideas improved average rated stories while AI-assisted stories were more similar to each other.
uncertainty: The study does not establish benefit for scientific discovery, integrative phenotypes, or society-wide change.
falsifier: Preregistered replication on completed research artifacts finds no individual-quality or diversity contrast.
rival: Task-specific anchoring explains similarity without a general AI effect.

title: Severe CACNA2D1 loss → impaired CaV2 function
scope: Two rare human cases plus functional assays
mechanism: Biallelic loss-of-function variants were linked to early epileptic encephalopathy and impaired CaV2 trafficking in assays.
uncertainty: Rare severe variants do not identify effects of common variation or ordinary perinatal exposure.
falsifier: Independent variant studies and orthogonal functional assays fail to reproduce the trafficking deficit.
rival: Other variants or pathways explain the clinical phenotype in these cases.
